explanation: Mathlib has `isQuasiregular_iff_isUnit'` in `Mathlib/Algebra/Algebra/Spectrum/Quasispectrum.lean`, relating quasiregularity to units in the unitization of the whole nonunital algebra. That does not directly give this result, which concerns matrices over the entrywise unitization. I also searched Mathlib for matrix/unitization and matrix/quasiregularity results but found no matching declaration.
